theorems.name: Submission.allard52_gps_fderiv_zero_apply
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (H : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n) (y : Rn ℓ), fderiv ℝ (fun A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ => (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection) 0 H (graphPoint x y) = graphPoint (∑ i : Fin n, inner ℝ (H (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) y • EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (H x)
